days.drive: TIV → Vrmac tunnel / Kotor → M-1 to Risan / Lipci → M-8 via Grahovo → M-7 to Nikšić → M-3 to Jasenovo Polje → M-6 via Šavnik → Runolist Chalet · nominal 3 h 20 min / 4 h adjusted (+20%); live route controls

morning.text: Planning estimate: flight lands at TIV at 13:50; flight number and ticket confirmation were not supplied.
Collect the estate car, test-load both checked cases and both cabin trolleys beneath the closed parcel shelf, photograph existing damage, and save the roadside number.
Planning estimate: aim to leave the airport around 15:15–15:30 only if landing, pickup, driver and road checks are all on track.

afternoon.text: Drive directly north to your Runolist Chalet via the Vrmac tunnel and Kotor, then M-1 to Risan/Lipci, M-8 via Grahovo, M-7 to Nikšić, M-3 to Jasenovo Polje and M-6 via Šavnik.
Check live navigation for closures or reroutes.
Use 3 h 20 min as a nominal published estimate; current sources vary and live traffic/weather can extend it, then add 20%: about 4 h adjusted, before traffic or stops.
That points to roughly 19:15–19:30 arrival.
Žabljak sunset on Oct 1 is about 18:26 and civil twilight ends about 18:55, so this deliberately breaks the usual daylight cutoff.
Do not add the Lepetane ferry, viewpoints, a swim, or a meal stop.

If the flight or rental is delayed, visibility/weather is poor, roads are restricted, or the driver is tired, stay at your stop safely and arrange lodging directly; resume only after a fresh road/weather and driver check and coordination with Runolist.
If conditions deteriorate after you leave, do not press on: stop at the next safe town, arrange lodging and secure the bags.

evening.text: Check in and unload every bag.
Eat near the lodging or use food arranged ahead.
The Runolist listing’s check-in window and late-arrival approval are not supplied; confirm directly with the host before travel.

days.parking: Go directly to Runolist Chalet, Narodnih heroja, 84220 Žabljak, and unload immediately. Listing information indicates free private parking; confirm the booked unit’s access and late arrival with the host. The booking confirmation number was not supplied.
days.cash: No planned toll or ferry. Keep a card and small cash notes accessible; fill the tank before the P14 day.

days.drive: Žabljak local · ~0.4 adjusted h; if Day 1 is aborted, reassess the transfer only after a fresh safety and host check

morning.text: If you arrived at Runolist on Day 1, recover after the airport-to-mountains transfer.
Go to Black Lake parking late morning.
Take the short forest-and-shore loop; allow about 2–2.5 hours.
Turn back if footing or weather turns.
Keep the Bosaca–Jablan Lake viewpoint as an optional, time-boxed out-and-back only if rested.
Do not attempt the reported seven-hour circular hike.
If Day 1 was aborted, do not force a catch-up drive; reassess road/weather, driver condition and Runolist arrival arrangements before leaving.
When safe to continue, drive directly to Runolist Chalet; skip Black Lake and other activities if needed to arrive safely.
Do not start a delayed highland transfer unless live conditions and daylight allow a safe arrival; cancel sightseeing first.
If Day 1 was delayed or aborted, reassess the live route, weather, driver condition and booked arrival arrangements before continuing; cancel sightseeing first.

afternoon.text: Finish the Black Lake visit and warm up.
Check the Day 3 P14 road and weather with AMSCG and your host.
If delayed from Day 1, go directly to Runolist, unload and check in; skip Black Lake.
If the northbound transfer remains unsafe, stop safely, contact the host, and arrange lodging directly; the booked stay dates remain Oct 1–4.

evening.text: Eat in Žabljak and get an early night before P14.
Ask the host which places are open and confirm the Sedlo road status again in the morning.

days.drive: Žabljak → P14/Sedlo → Trsa → Plužine/Piva viewpoint → return · plan 4 h 30 wheel time / 5 h 24 adjusted; LIVE ROUTE GATE REQUIRED

morning.text: Make this your P14 day.
Start around 07:30 after checking AMSCG, the forecast and your lodging host for the Sedlo pass.
Enter P-14 only if it is open, dry enough, and clear of ice or low cloud.
Put Žabljak → Trsa → Plužine/Piva viewpoint → Žabljak into Google Maps before leaving.
The whole out-and-back is provisionally 4 h 30 behind the wheel, or 5 h 24 after +20%.
Go only if the live total is at most 5 h 30.

afternoon.text: Stay on P-14 over Sedlo (about 1,911 m).
It is paved, narrow and winding, with two-way traffic and few comfortable passing places; use signed pullouts and expect to reverse to a passing place.
Give the drive about 2 h 15 each way.
Allow time for photo and lunch stops.
Stop at the Plužine/Piva viewpoint and lakeside, then turn around.
Skip Mratinje Dam and the cheese-farm detour unless Maps still shows ≤5 h 30 adjusted and a Žabljak return by 16:00.
If the core loop exceeds the cap or fails the safety gate, cancel P14 and return to Runolist or remain at base; choose a local low-risk walk only if conditions allow.

evening.text: Get back to Žabljak before dark.
Do not tack on the seven-hour Jablan Lake circular hike.
If P14 is cancelled, use the short Bosača out-and-back as a separate, time-boxed alternative.

days.parking: Start and finish at Žabljak with luggage secured. Use signed pullouts; never stop on blind bends. Download the road map and Maps.me trail data offline.
days.cash: Budget €5/person for the Durmitor day ticket if charged; the €13.50/person 2026 annual pass can cover the three planned park days. Keep small notes for village food.

days.drive: Runolist Chalet → Conte Hotel & Restaurant, Perast · allow ~3 h 40 adjusted as a planning estimate; live route and parking approach control

morning.text: Leave Žabljak by 07:00.
Retrace M-6 via Šavnik to Jasenovo Polje, M-3 to Nikšić, M-7 to Vilusi, M-8 through Grahovo to Lipci, then M-1 north to Conte Hotel & Restaurant in Perast.
Allow about 3 h 04 before the +20% terrain buffer, around 3 h 41 adjusted as a conservative estimate; add time for live traffic and the Perast parking approach.
Check road/weather notices before rolling; never route across Đurđevića Tara Bridge, which is closed through Oct 26 at noon.

afternoon.text: Go to the signed parking area at the Perast entrance; vehicles cannot enter the old town in May–October. Contact Conte about assistance from parking to reception, unload and check in.
Do not add a Kotor stop while luggage is in the car.
Conte publishes check-in from 15:00; confirm the individual booking and arrival plan. After unloading, rest or explore Perast on foot.

evening.text: Book dinner in Perast or near Conte and leave the car put.
Keep the car in the signed entrance parking area; walk Perast’s historic core.

days.parking: Conte Hotel & Restaurant, Ul. Marka Martinovića bb, 85336 Perast. days.drive: Perast ↔ selected Bay / Skadar outing · live route controls; allow about 3 h 30–4 h adjusted for Virpazar round trip

morning.text: Choose one outing; do not try to cram all three into the last full day.
For Skadar, leave Perast around 08:00 for Virpazar.
The scenic route uses R-1 toward Njeguši/Cetinje, then R-15; the coastal option is M-1 through Budva and Petrovac, M-1.1 through the tolled Sozina Tunnel, then M-2/R-15.
Follow live routing around works and weather.
Book a boat only after the operator confirms an October departure and return time.
The park lists €5/person/day and says one cruise is included; verify that it covers your chosen trip.
Old €10 group / €50 private fares are traveler history, not quotes.

afternoon.text: On the Skadar option, be ashore by 15:45.
Eat in Virpazar.
Add a Godinje winery only with a reservation.
Choose a sober driver for the winery stop.
For Perast, park at the signed lot.
Walk the old lanes.
Take the island boat only if it is running.
Budva/Sveti Stefan is the beach-and-old-town alternative.
Traffic and parking can eat the afternoon; skip Budva if crowds annoy you.
Return to Conte in Perast before dark.

evening.text: Have the final dinner in Perast.
Leave bags at Conte Hotel & Restaurant.
Keep tomorrow’s airport run simple and predictable.

days.parking: Leave bags at Conte. For Perast, park at a signed entrance lot and walk. For Virpazar or Budva, use marked public lots; never leave valuables visible in the car.
days.cash: Carry €20–40/person for the chosen outing. Three park days at €5 each cost €15/person; the 2026 all-parks annual pass is €13.50/person, if all three admissions are required.

morning.text: Have breakfast at 08:30.
Leave Perast by 09:30 as a conservative planning target; confirm live routing.
Take the direct road to TIV; do not detour for a last viewpoint.
Refuel only if your contract requires it, photograph the fuel gauge and car condition, and return the car by 11:30.

afternoon.text: Walk to the terminal and be inside by 12:15 for the required counter check-in.
Planning estimate: flight departure is 14:55; flight number and ticket confirmation were not supplied.
Do not gamble on rental inspection queues or airport procedures.

days.parking: Check out of Conte by its published 11:00 deadline (confirm the booking). Leave with generous traffic buffer, return car by the existing 11:30 planning target and reach the terminal by 12:15. Flight and rental voucher details were not supplied.

budget.label: Rental · estate/wagon + insurance
budget.note: Five-day planning allowance. Exact midsize estate, low-excess SCDW, glass, tires/wheels, underbody/gravel and roadside cover must be quoted.

budget.label: Fuel + tolls
budget.note: Planning range covers TIV→Runolist Chalet and Runolist Chalet→Perast transfers, P14 out-and-back mileage and mountain elevation gains. Transfer mileage is roughly neutral versus the former TIV→Kotor + Kotor→Žabljak sequence. The primary route does not require the ferry, Sozina or A1; fuel rates must be rechecked for the travel week.

budget.label: Parks + boat + walls + spa
budget.note: Planning allowance for two-person admissions, Kotor walls (optional day visit) and optional spa. Durmitor and Skadar list €5/person/day; Skadar lists one cruise included. For the primary route, three planned park days total €15/person versus €13.50/person for the 2026 all-parks annual pass, if separate admission is charged each day.  Confirm ticket terms and October operations.

budget.label: Food & drink
budget.note: €90–150 per couple per day, including one winery/local tasting allowance.

budget.label: Contingency cash
budget.note: Carry €100–150 in small cash notes; reserve total also covers weather reroutes, fuel and unplanned fees.
